notes.title: Mini-game - new objective mechanic

notes.title: New alpha 0.1.2.5 build
notes.content:
Added new juke move by holding control button and doing combinations of AWSD keys. Also adjusted camera position and movement whilst freely moving.

Also improved pathfinding for AI when chasing and fixed a few bugs related the AI.
